title: ANCOVA with a slope-homogeneity decision rule and covariate-adjusted means
source_relation: adapted: explicit decision tree, function-style contract, normal-equation oracle
difficulty_hypothesis: Agents enter treatment before the covariate (unadjusted F), skip the slope test and always report parallel-slope adjusted effects, evaluate adjusted means at baseline = 0 or at group-specific baselines, or fail to switch to conditional means when slopes differ.

mcp_relevance.rationale: Model specification and covariate reasoning in base R; no package or version fact is needed.
mcp_relevance.information_need: Which F test adjusts for the covariate, and how to evaluate fitted means at fixed covariate values.
mcp_relevance.obtainable_without_mcp: yes: lm, anova and predict are documented locally
alternative_solution_paths: explicit design matrices with RSS differences
drop1 on the parallel model for the adjusted treatment F
